# Mitchell Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Mitchell. Thermostat repair and replacement covers diagnosis of thermostat faults and installation of compatible replacement controls.

Email: contact@mitchellheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://mitchellheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Mitchell, Stratford, Seaforth, Goderich, Listowel, Clinton, Wingham. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
